from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
audit=json.loads(Path("reports/T0007/review-r2/final-audit.json").read_text())
assert audit["result"]=="PASS" and audit["task_status"]=="accepted" and not audit["open_findings"]
for p,h in (audit["accepted_files"]|audit["artifact_sha256"]).items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,p
frozen=json.loads(Path("reports/T0007/review-r2-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
for p,h in frozen["history_sha256"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,p
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()==audit["head"]
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","branch","--show-current"],text=True).strip()=="T0007-relation-dag"
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],check=True)
paths=subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard","-z"]).decode().split("\0")
paths=[p for p in paths if p]
for p in paths:
    assert p in {"docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md","src/kmesh/logic/dependency.py","tests/test_dependency.py"} or p.startswith("reports/T0007/"),p
    assert not any(x in Path(p).parts for x in ("pytest-tmp","__pycache__")),p
    assert Path(p).stat().st_size < 10_000_000,p
print("PASS: accepted source, tests and artifacts unchanged; preserved",len(frozen["history_sha256"]),"historical files.")
print("PASS: expected branch/base, diff hygiene, pending file scope and size; no scratch files.")
